title.narrative: Tanzania Productive Social Safety Net Project II

description.narrative: The objective of the Productive Social Safety Net II Project in Tanzania is to improve access to income-earning opportunities and socio-economic services for targeted poor households while enhancing and protecting the human capital of their children. This project is comprised of two components. The first component will provide beneficiary households with an integrated package of support, including a foundational package and livelihoods support. The two subcomponents are: (1) Cash Transfers; (2) Public Works. The second subcomponent is Strengthening Institutional Capacity and Integrated Delivery Systems. The two subcomponents are: (1) Institutional Capacity Enhancement, and; (2) Integrated delivery system development.
To improve access to income-earning opportunities and socio-economic services for targeted poor households while enhancing and protecting the human capital of their children.

title.narrative: Beneficiaries receiving information on livelihood enhancement services

comment.narrative: This indicator was time-bound rather than cumulative, with decreasing targets that intended to measure a reduced caseload after recertification, as stipulated in the AF. The number of households exiting the program after recertification was slightly higher than originally envisioned, leaving 901,721 households in the program by June 30, 2025. By closing, some additional households exited the program after receiving their productive grants in addition to natural exits that occurred during every cycle. The target was revised to reflect the target in the AF of 960,000 households.

The indicator measures the non-cumulative number of unique beneficiary households receiving transfers at a specific point in time, rather than the cumulative number of beneficiary households (analogous to PDI 1, but expressed in terms of households rather than individuals). At project closure, the actual value fell below the envisioned target, primarily due to a higher-than-anticipated rate of household exits, including exits following recertification and after completion of all program activities.
Beneficiaries receiving support from both CT and Public Works.
